description: Declared read-ledger for the QueryPat metadata pipeline. Records which full-text sources have been swept and which passes are done/partial/blocked, so a future session never re-reads a source already cooked into the system files. Fine-grained per-unit status (e.g. which Exegesis segments are summarized, which works carry locations) is DERIVED live by scripts/processing/coverage.py from the data the site serves; this file holds the coarse 'has the source text been read' facts that cannot be derived from the output.

exegesis.where: exegesis_ordered.txt (9 MB, in repo) and raw_text in site/public/data/segments/*.json (882 of 1107 segments retain raw_text)
exegesis.note: 224 segments lack raw_text in the export; their text can be recovered from exegesis_ordered.txt by date/position or by re-exporting from the SQLite DB.

novels_and_stories.where: database/extracted_markdown/ (gitignored, ~37 MB) regenerated from 'PKD stuff to add/' source PDFs (external, gitignored). Neither is present in a fresh clone.
novels_and_stories.note: Work-LEVEL locations and themes are groundable from documented settings/scholarship. CHAPTER-LEVEL summaries are BLOCKED here: they require the full texts and cannot be produced without fabrication.

letters.where: Selected Letters volumes are external archive PDFs (gitignored). Hand-extracted letter events exist in scripts/letters/handextracted_batch1.json and batch2.json.
letters.note: Letter LOCATIONS/summaries at scale need the volumes. The hand-extracted batches and any letter text quoted inside the Exegesis (e.g. the Gene Savoy letter in SECTION_013) are usable now.

biography.note: Locations are a per-event string field; 489/687 events and 162/162 curated events already carry one.

EXEG_SECTION_013.note: All processable positions summarized (waves 0-1). Exemplar batch (positions 1-6) established the schema.
